result.fundName: ICICI Prudential US Bluechip Equity Fund - Direct Plan -  Growth

insights: ICICI Prudential US Bluechip Equity Fund - Direct Plan -  Growth marginally outperforms its benchmark on rolling returns by 0.94% (15.62% vs 14.68%).
Chance of beating benchmark is 57.4% — moderate consistency, below the 70% Golden Triangle threshold.
Risk-adjusted returns are superior: Sharpe 0.78 vs benchmark 0.63, Sortino 1.07.
Benchmark-like risk shape: beta 0.21, volatility within 5% of the index.
Positive alpha of 12.34% suggests manager skill beyond market exposure (info ratio 0.15).
Higher drawdown risk: fund max drawdown -24.65% vs benchmark -38.11%.
Rolling return range spans 8.43% to 21.99% (13.56 pp spread) — consistency score 74.
Failed criteria: Chance of Beating Benchmark.
